name: wiro-ai
description: Official MCP server for Wiro AI. Search, price and run 1,000+ image, video, audio and LLM models, build workflows that chain them, and deploy and message AI agents.

WIRO_API_KEY.description: API key of a Wiro project, from https://wiro.ai/panel/project. Not needed when you sign in with OAuth on the hosted server. Never commit your key.

WIRO_API_SECRET.description: API secret of the same project. Only needed when the project uses signature auth; leave it empty for API key only projects.

npm.description: Local stdio. Requires Node.js 20 or later.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in with your Wiro account. Model runs are billed from your Wiro wallet.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP with a Wiro API key instead of OAuth, for a project that uses API key only auth.

http-signature.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP for a project that uses signature auth. The header carries the API key and secret joined with a colon.
